thread:
viv: Noticing missing hourly aggregates for shard s-47 between 2024-08-03T02:00 and 2024-08-03T05:00. Looks like ~320M events. Need a targeted backfill.
ash: Can we do a dry-run to know cost and impact before scheduling?
ravi: Scheduler doesn't expose a planner API yet. We can add POST /planner/dry_run to return shards, estimated_rows, cost_eur, and plan_id.
viv: Nice. Console should require a plan_id before enabling Start. Also show "estimated duration" and a small confidence interval.
ash: Routing concerns: use affinity=backfill_pool so we don't steal prod capacity; fallback to preemptible nodes with soft-preempt semantics.
ravi: Soft-preempt: backfill workers checkpoint every N minutes and yield slots when higher-priority requests arrive. We'll wire alert-mute for the run_id so SLO pages don't page during sanctioned maintenance.
viv: Can someone run the dry-run for s-47 and share plan_id?
planner-bot: planner dry_run accepted -> plan_id: pl_20240803_s47_1; shards: [s-47]; est_rows: 320000000; cost_eur: 820; est_time_95pct: 2h-4h.
ash: I'll do a 20m canary against tenant acme first. If good, we promote using the plan_id.
ravi: I'll open a short RFC for planner API, plan_id gating, backfill_pool affinity, and console preflight UI.
viv: Thanks team, proceeding with canary.
